requirements.title: Agent tool calls are intercepted and recorded
requirements.text: At least one coding host is wired to the KYA gate or PreToolUse hook, so agent tool calls are evaluated and written to the trail before execution.

requirements.title: No high-stakes writes allowed in hold mode
requirements.text: In hold mode the gate must not ALLOW high-stakes writes; every HIGH_STAKES_WRITE must be DENY or REQUIRE_APPROVE.

requirements.title: No shell execution allowed in hold mode
requirements.text: In hold mode the gate must not ALLOW shell execution; every SHELL_EXEC must be DENY or REQUIRE_APPROVE.

requirements.title: Redaction by construction
requirements.text: Raw tool arguments and secrets are never persisted to the trail, receipts, or reports; only hashes and clipped redacted previews.

check.prompt: Confirm the agent configuration never persists raw secrets or full arguments to local evidence stores.

requirements.title: Bounded local evidence retention
requirements.text: Trail and receipt retention is bounded (rotation or operator deletion policy) and the retention window is known.

check.prompt: Confirm trail/receipt retention is bounded and state the retention window.

requirements.title: Gate enforces, not observe-only
requirements.text: The policy gate runs in an enforcing mode (hold or offline), not observe-only.

requirements.title: Deny path is exercised
requirements.text: At least one DENY verdict in the last 90 days proves enforcement is live, not theoretical.

requirements.title: Human approval path is exercised
requirements.text: At least one REQUIRE_APPROVE verdict in the last 90 days proves the human gate is reachable.

requirements.title: ORR security posture is not red
requirements.text: The security_platform category of the latest ORR report is green or amber.

requirements.title: No unknown tools allowed in hold mode
requirements.text: In hold mode the gate must not ALLOW calls it cannot classify (UNKNOWN_TOOL).

requirements.title: Never-events are never allowed
requirements.text: Tools on the never-list were never ALLOWed in the last 365 days.

requirements.title: Sandbox available for high-risk execution
requirements.text: At least one sandbox record exists for isolating high-risk tool execution.

requirements.title: Latest ORR overall is not red
requirements.text: The overall rating of the latest ORR report is green or amber.

requirements.title: Destructive operations require human approval
requirements.text: Destructive or irreversible tool calls map to REQUIRE_APPROVE or DENY in policy, never silent ALLOW.

check.prompt: Confirm destructive/irreversible tool calls map to REQUIRE_APPROVE or DENY, never silent ALLOW.

requirements.title: Blocked actions have a retry policy
requirements.text: A documented policy bounds automated retries of DENYed or held actions so blocks cannot be brute-forced.

check.prompt: Confirm a policy bounds automated retries of blocked actions (no bypass loops).

requirements.title: Trail recording is active
requirements.text: At least one trail event in the last 7 days proves the evidence pipeline is live.

requirements.title: Unknown-tool rate is bounded
requirements.text: UNKNOWN_TOOL calls stay at or below 5% of evaluations over the last 30 days.

requirements.title: ORR evidence is fresh (30 days)
requirements.text: The latest ORR report is at most 30 days old.

requirements.title: Evidence pipeline continuity is monitored
requirements.text: The report daemon / evidence pipeline restarts on failure under a named supervisor (pm2, systemd, monit, launchd).

check.prompt: Name the supervisor that restarts the evidence pipeline on failure.

requirements.title: Receipts are generated
requirements.text: At least one activity receipt exists in .kya/receipts.

requirements.title: Session identity on all events
requirements.text: Every trail event carries a sessionId (schema-enforced) traceable to an operator or run.

check.prompt: Confirm every trail event carries a sessionId (schema-enforced) and sessions are traceable to an operator or run.

requirements.title: Project attribution on events
requirements.text: Trail events carry project attribution (working-directory basename) and projects map to owned repositories.

check.prompt: Confirm trail events carry project attribution and projects map to owned repositories.

requirements.title: ORR evidence exists (90 days)
requirements.text: An ORR report exists and is at most 90 days old.

requirements.title: Cost showback is available
requirements.text: A showback card (.kya/usage.json) exists for cost review.

requirements.title: Named human policy owner
requirements.text: A named human is accountable for the agent's policy configuration and is reachable.

check.prompt: Name the human accountable for the agent's policy configuration and how they are reached.

requirements.title: Acceptable-use policy
requirements.text: An acceptable-use policy bounds what the agent may do.

check.prompt: Link or quote the acceptable-use policy bounding what the agent may do.

requirements.title: Incident-response runbook
requirements.text: An incident-response runbook covers agent misbehavior.

check.prompt: Link or quote the incident-response runbook covering agent misbehavior.

requirements.title: Third-party model disclosure
requirements.text: The third-party models/providers the agent uses are disclosed to users.

check.prompt: List the third-party models/providers the agent uses and where this is disclosed.

requirements.title: Data-processing terms
requirements.text: Data-processing terms cover user data handled by the agent.

check.prompt: Link or quote the data-processing terms covering user data handled by the agent.

requirements.title: Human escalation contact
requirements.text: A human escalation contact is published for agent-caused harm.

check.prompt: Publish the human escalation contact for agent-caused harm.
